name: FineClock
summary: FineClock is a utility EA that displays a customizable clock overlay on all open charts in MetaTrader 5. It supports local time, server time, and GMT, with configurable font, color, shadow, and corner positioning. The EA uses a timer to update the display every second or every minute depending on the chosen format.
summary_zh: FineClock是一个工具型EA，在MetaTrader 5所有打开的图表上显示可自定义的时钟叠加层。它支持本地时间、服务器时间和GMT时间，可配置字体、颜色、阴影和角落位置。EA根据所选格式每秒或每分钟刷新显示。
strategy_analysis: 此EA不涉及任何交易策略，它纯粹是一个图表显示工具。它在图表上创建两个标签对象（一个用于阴影效果，一个用于主文字），通过定时器事件周期性更新时间显示。入场条件和出场条件不适用，因为没有交易逻辑。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。其核心逻辑是利用OnTimer回调获取当前时间（本地/服务器/GMT），格式化后通过ObjectSetString更新标签文本。阴影效果通过创建偏移的第二个标签对象实现，并可在OnTimer中同步位置和字体属性。该EA遍历所有打开的图表窗口，仅对可见窗口执行更新以优化性能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not involve any trading strategy; it is purely a chart display utility. It creates two label objects on the chart (one for shadow effect, one for main text), periodically updating the time display through timer events. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since there is no trading logic. Position sizing and money management are likewise not applicable. Its core logic uses the OnTimer callback to fetch the current time (local/server/GMT), format it, and update label text via ObjectSetString. The shadow effect is achieved by creating a second offset label object, with position and font properties synchronized in OnTimer. The EA iterates through all open chart windows, only updating visible ones to optimize performance.

parameters.name: TimeType
parameters.description: 时间类型：本地时间/服务器时间/GMT

parameters.name: Fmt
parameters.description: 时钟格式：秒(时:分:秒)或分(时:分)

parameters.name: Corner
parameters.description: 时钟显示的图表角落位置

pros: 支持三种时间源（本地/服务器/GMT），满足不同交易时段需求
阴影效果增强视觉可读性，设计细节周到
仅对可见图表窗口执行更新，避免不必要的性能开销
参数化程度高，用户可自定义位置、字体、颜色等几乎所有视觉属性
OnDeinit中正确清理创建的图表对象，避免残留
pros_en: Supports three time sources (local/server/GMT) to meet different trading session needs
Shadow effect enhances visual readability with thoughtful design details
Only updates visible chart windows, avoiding unnecessary performance overhead
Highly parameterized — users can customize nearly all visual attributes including position, font, and color
Properly cleans up created chart objects in OnDeinit, preventing leftover artifacts
cons: 代码中存在非ASCII枚举名（如�MyCorners），可能导致编码兼容性问题
OnInit中ObjectFind的用法有误——ObjectFind返回-1表示未找到，但代码用+1后判断bool，逻辑不够直观且可能在某些边缘情况下出错
依赖外部include文件（eIntNumbers.mqh和eFloatNumbers.mqh），这些文件可能不在标准路径中
注释为乱码（编码问题），严重影响代码可读性和可维护性
秒级定时器模式下未考虑服务器时间与本地时间的同步偏差
cons_en: Non-ASCII enum names (e.g., �MyCorners) may cause encoding compatibility issues
ObjectFind usage in OnInit is error-prone — it returns -1 when not found, but the code adds 1 and casts to bool, which is unintuitive and may fail in edge cases
Depends on external include files (eIntNumbers.mqh, eFloatNumbers.mqh) that may not be in standard paths
Comments are garbled due to encoding issues, severely hurting readability and maintainability
No consideration for synchronization offset between server and local time in second-level timer mode
improvements: 修复编码问题，将枚举名和注释改为英文或UTF-8兼容字符
修正ObjectFind的逻辑判断，改为标准的>=0检查方式
移除对外部include文件的依赖，使用标准MQL5类型或内联实现参数范围校验
improvements_en: Fix encoding issues by converting enum names and comments to English or UTF-8-compatible characters
Fix ObjectFind logic to use standard >=0 check instead of the hacky +1 bool cast
Remove dependency on external include files by using standard MQL5 types or inline parameter range validation

risk_points: 此EA不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
外部include文件缺失可能导致编译失败，但不会造成交易损失
risk_points_en: This EA performs no trading operations, posing no financial risk
Missing external include files may cause compilation failure but no trading losses
